mostWorthwhile.text: Building the reef partnership and then a coastal mosaic was most worthwhile: it connected symbiosis and inherited skeletons to the shelter provided by distinct habitats.

leastWorthwhile.text: Repeatedly inspecting objects with only one available partner felt somewhat mechanical, even though it advanced the reef sequence.

surprise.text: I expected swimming animals to combine directly with the coral reef, but the reef had no available combinations; the animals instead used the kelp forest as nursery habitat.

arbitrary.text: The final use of tides was not clear from the goal alone, although the result explained their role in moving water and nutrients.

continue.text: I would continue: the cave's hint of a future visitor and the emergence of connected habitats made me curious about what the world might make next.
